blind_spot_rule: A blind spot is not quiet. A requirement whose evidence public sources cannot see (low or no scanability) and that has no active reports is invisible to this tool, not calm; its silence is not evidence of anything.

coverage_status.label: quiet
coverage_status.meaning: No active reports, and public sources could see movement if there were any.

coverage_status.label: blind spot
coverage_status.meaning: No active reports, and public sources cannot see this requirement: absence is not evidence, so never call it quiet.

direction.label: supports
direction.meaning: Makes progress on the requirement more likely or easier.

direction.label: threatens
direction.meaning: Makes progress on the requirement less likely or harder.

direction.label: two-way
direction.meaning: Bears on the requirement with no clear direction, or both ways at once.

direction.label: informs the baseline
direction.meaning: Changes what we know about where the requirement stands now.

discipline.label: osint web
discipline.meaning: Open web search with a query text.

discipline.label: osint feed
discipline.meaning: Items read from the feeds of watched sources, matched to a query.

discipline.label: osint site
discipline.meaning: Web search restricted to the domains of named watched sources.

discipline.label: osint academic
discipline.meaning: Scholarly indexes searched with a query text.

discipline.label: geoint
discipline.meaning: Reserved: geospatial intelligence, not collected in version 1.

discipline.label: sensor
discipline.meaning: Reserved: sensor and monitoring data, not collected in version 1.

disposition_outcome.label: promoted
disposition_outcome.meaning: Became a new intelligence report, named by report_id.

disposition_outcome.label: rejected
disposition_outcome.meaning: Fails the promotion test; the reason says which part.

disposition_outcome.label: duplicate
disposition_outcome.meaning: The same development as another candidate or report; report_id may name it.

disposition_outcome.label: deferred
disposition_outcome.meaning: Not judged yet; a later submission may dispose of it.

disposition_outcome.label: reinforcement
disposition_outcome.meaning: A new sighting of an existing report, named by report_id and confirmed in reinforcements.

finding_kind.label: Passed event horizons
finding_kind.meaning: The event horizon has passed and nobody has updated or verified the report since.

finding_kind.label: Future-framed language
finding_kind.meaning: The title, summary or notes use future-framed language that rots once the date passes.

finding_kind.label: Stale verifications
finding_kind.meaning: The report was last verified more than 45 days ago.

finding_kind.label: Never verified
finding_kind.meaning: The report has never been verified against its source.

indicator_state.label: emerging
indicator_state.meaning: New to the register, seen in one run only.

indicator_state.label: tracking
indicator_state.meaning: Seen again in a strictly later run than the one that found it.

indicator_state.label: reinforced
indicator_state.meaning: Seen by three distinct sources, or independently confirmed by the analyst.

indicator_state.label: matured
indicator_state.meaning: Settled context, set by the analyst; sightings are still recorded.

indicator_state.label: faded
indicator_state.meaning: Not seen in the two most recent complete runs; set by the sweep, revived by a sighting.

indicator_state.label: parked
indicator_state.meaning: Set aside by the analyst; sightings are still recorded.

scanability.label: high
scanability.meaning: Public sources see the drivers and the evidence well.

scanability.label: medium
scanability.meaning: Public sources see the drivers, but the evidence only at release.

scanability.label: low
scanability.meaning: Evidence is mostly internal; public sources see it only in known windows.

scanability.label: none
scanability.meaning: Evidence is wholly internal; no public source will ever report on it.

undercount: Counts of reports are not counts of impact. The register shows what surfaced publicly: at least this much, and known to undercount.

yield_reading.label: earning its place
yield_reading.meaning: At least one of its candidates was promoted to a report.

yield_reading.label: high volume no promotions
yield_reading.meaning: Twenty or more candidates and no promotion: noise to tune out or a query to tighten.

yield_reading.label: low volume
yield_reading.meaning: Fewer than twenty candidates and no promotion yet.

yield_reading.label: silent
yield_reading.meaning: An active source that has not returned a hit in any run.
